'''2018 European Championship Day 2 Moritz Karge LS Combat Preparedness (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Moritz Karge]] at [[2018 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Moritz Karge]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine (Light) (Premiere)|Premiere-L-tatooine.gif|label=Tatooine}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Combat Preparedness (V) Karge LS.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127125624/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-championships/ Internet Archive]
